effects.printed_clause: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: Place 1 Candy Counter on 1 face-up monster your opponent controls, or place 2 instead if you control another Skewy! monster.
effects.lua_implementation: The optional Normal/Special Summon trigger now uses TRIGGER_O, and both target and operation count two counters only when another face-up Skewy monster is controlled.

official_references.matched_structure: Counter capacity checking and exact counter placement.
Cloned Normal/Special Summon triggers sharing a hard once-per-turn key.

effects.issue: Confirmed and corrected: face-down monsters cannot satisfy the public archetype condition. The fresh review also corrected the unprinted mandatory trigger type.

effects.printed_clause: Monsters your opponent controls with Candy Counters cannot activate their effects while you control a Skewy! monster.
effects.lua_implementation: The continuous activation lock is enabled only while the controller has a face-up Skewy monster, and applies to opposing monsters carrying Candy Counters.

official_references.matched_structure: Field EFFECT_CANNOT_TRIGGER prevents affected monsters from activating effects.

effects.issue: Confirmed and corrected: the prior Card.IsSetCard-only condition allowed a face-down monster to establish an archetype-qualified condition.

effects.lua_implementation: The cloned 300 ATK-loss effect shares the corrected face-up Skewy enabling condition and still applies only to opposing monsters with Candy Counters.

official_references.matched_structure: Applies a fixed ATK reduction alongside effect suppression.
Continuous field ATK reduction with a target predicate.

effects.issue: Confirmed and corrected with the shared condition used by the activation lock.

effects.printed_clause: Quick Effect: You can remove exactly 2 Candy Counters from monsters your opponent controls; draw 1 card or Special Summon 1 Skewy! monster from your Deck in Defense Position, but its effects are negated until the end of this turn.
effects.lua_implementation: A free-chain Quick Effect removes exactly two counters from the opponent's Monster Zone as cost, chooses draw or Deck summon at activation, summons in face-up Defense Position, and applies EFFECT_DISABLE/EFFECT_DISABLE_EFFECT through the End Phase.

official_references.matched_structure: Deck Special Summon with effects negated.
Temporary effect negation with an End Phase reset.

effects.printed_clause: You can only use each effect of Skewy! Candee-Hex once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: The summon-counter and Quick Effects use id and id+100 hard once-per-turn keys.

coverage_override.reason: Five records cover summon counters, Candy-Counter activation lock, ATK loss, counter-removal choice effect, and per-effect HOPT.
